* security: filter caps/creds, validate env inputs, dedup cache, harden CI (PER-8554-8558)

Resolves four High-severity AppSec findings (and chains C-003 PER-8563,
C-004 PER-8564):

PER-8557 (CWE-284/CWE-312) — full Appium capabilities (incl.
bstack:options.accessKey) and commandExecutorUrl were forwarded verbatim to
the Percy CLI/cloud. Add filterCapabilities() (allowlist: platformName,
deviceName, osVersion, platformVersion, browserName, orientation,
percy:options) and sanitizeCommandExecutorUrl() (strips user:pass@). Applied
inside the cached lookups so secrets never enter the cache.

PER-8558 (CWE-639/CWE-362) — process-global capability cache could cross-leak
across sessions and raced on concurrent same-key access. Add promise-dedup so
overlapping callers await one computation; filtering creds before caching
(above) removes the credential-leak content.

PER-8555 (CWE-285 + CWE-22) — AA_DOMAIN was substring-matched with no
validation (empty value matched every host); PERCY_TMP_DIR was used unvalidated
for fs writes. Ignore empty/whitespace AA_DOMAIN (fall back to the trusted
default); validate PERCY_TMP_DIR resolves within the system temp dir before
mkdir/tmp.file, else warn + fall back.

PER-8554 (CWE-829) — CI hardening: SHA-pin all actions, add least-privilege
permissions to every workflow, pin the Semgrep image by digest, and fix a
BRNACH->BRANCH env typo in the dispatch path.

Tests: 172 passing (+13 new); eslint clean.

NOTE: capability filtering changes the payload sent to the Percy CLI. The CLI
authenticates to BrowserStack via its own env credentials (no reference to the
forwarded accessKey in @percy/core), but flagging for review.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test: cover security-hardening branches (cache dedup, tmp-dir mkdir, url regex fallback)

Restore 100% coverage after the security hardening changes. Adds:
- cache dedup path: concurrent same-key callers share one in-flight
  promise; settled cached exception is rethrown on a later call
- sanitizeCommandExecutorUrl regex fallback for unparseable URLs
- genericProvider tempFile creates the resolved PERCY_TMP_DIR when it
  is a valid subdirectory of the system temp dir

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* revert(providers): drop AA_DOMAIN + PERCY_TMP_DIR env-var validation (PER-8555 won't-fix, machine-access)

PER-8555 (T2) re-triaged as won't-fix: exploiting the env-var overrides
requires the attacker to already control the environment variable on the
customer's machine. Restores the original unvalidated behavior for both
AA_DOMAIN (AppAutomate provider hub match) and PERCY_TMP_DIR (temp-file
path) and removes the associated unit tests. The other findings
(8554 CI hardening, 8557 capability/URL sanitization, 8558 cache dedup)
are untouched.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
